title: Creative Writing: Find Your Voice
subject: Creative Writing
description: An 18-week writer's workshop: craft one piece per unit and end with a published anthology.

milestones.title: The writer's eye
milestones.description: Observation, sensory detail, and showing instead of telling.
milestones.projectIdea: Sit somewhere busy for 20 minutes and write one paragraph so vivid a reader can smell it.
milestones.resourceHint: Library: any collection of personal essays

milestones.title: Characters
milestones.description: Building people: desires, flaws, and contradictions.
milestones.projectIdea: Character dossier: interview your protagonist about their worst day.
milestones.resourceHint: Khan Academy: Elements of a story

milestones.title: Setting and world
milestones.description: Place as a character; worlds that feel lived-in.
milestones.projectIdea: Map an imaginary place, then set a scene in its most interesting corner.

milestones.title: Dialogue
milestones.description: Voices on the page: subtext, conflict, and rhythm.
milestones.projectIdea: Two-character scene where no one says what they mean — show it all through dialogue.
milestones.resourceHint: Any play script for dialogue study

milestones.title: Plot and structure
milestones.description: Story shapes, tension, and endings that land.
milestones.projectIdea: Take a fairy tale apart, map its beats, and rebuild it in a new setting.

milestones.title: Point of view and voice
milestones.description: First, second, third — and finding yours.
milestones.projectIdea: Rewrite one scene three times: three narrators, three voices.

milestones.title: Poetry and compression
milestones.description: Saying more with less; image and line breaks.
milestones.projectIdea: Five poems about one ordinary object, each under 12 lines.

milestones.title: Revision
milestones.description: Real writing is rewriting: cutting, reordering, sharpening.
milestones.projectIdea: Take your weakest earlier piece and revise it three times — keep a change log.

milestones.title: Capstone: The anthology
milestones.description: Collect, order, and publish your best work.
milestones.projectIdea: Produce a real book (print or shared PDF) with a title, cover, and author's note.
milestones.resourceHint: Free tools: Google Docs or Canva for layout
